title: Add an UNDER_REVIEW report status
task: DX-103: Hold reports flagged for manual review
Compliance needs to park a submitted report while a human checks it.
Today the only states are draft, submitted, approved and archived, so a
flagged report can be approved by anyone before the check happens.
1. A new status `under_review` exists between submitted and approved.
2. approve_report MUST refuse to approve a report whose status is
under_review, returning 409 with an explanatory error.
3. Existing rows must keep working: reports written before this change
have no knowledge of the new status and must not break any read path.
4. The change ships with a migration for existing rows.
diff: @@ -60,6 +60,17 @@ def submit_report(request: dict[str, Any], report_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+def flag_for_review(request: dict[str, Any], report_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    row = query_one("SELECT * FROM reports WHERE id = ?", (report_id,))
+    execute("UPDATE reports SET status = ? WHERE id = ?", (ReportStatus.UNDER_REVIEW.value, report_id))
